searchQueries.title: Search terms
searchQueries.description: Search terms, e.g. ["laptop", "kaffeemaschine"]. Builds https://www.otto.de/suche/<term>/ URLs.

searchUrls.title: Search / category URLs (optional)
searchUrls.description: Full Otto.de search or category URLs to scrape instead of / in addition to search terms.

maxPages.title: Max pages per search
maxPages.description: Number of result pages to fetch per search (page param ?page=N).

maxProducts.title: Max products total
maxProducts.description: Overall cap on products pushed to the dataset.
